messages:
mila: Heads up — noticed several dashboards show a gap in api_request_count and avg_latency for the window 2026-11-01 03:00 -> 2026-11-01 07:00. Noticed missing parquet files in s3://redwood-telemetry/ingest/date=2026-11-01/partition=*
ashwin: ugh. is this a late ingest or a failed job?
joel: checking the ingest logs now. I see the kafka consumer had a restart at 03:12 and then a bunch of offsets were committed twice. possible duplicates or gaps.
sarah: can we avoid full reprocess if it’s just a few partitions? what’s the surface impact on aggregate tables and dashboards?
mila: looks like two things: (1) ~6h of missing raw batches for region=us-east-1, (2) some aggregate recompute attempted but failed halfway due to parquet schema mismatch (we changed a field name). so aggregates are partially recomputed.
ashwin: proposed plan: (A) backfill raw by replaying from kafka offsets for that window into a backfill prefix; (B) run recompute-agg job in incremental mode partitioned by hour; (C) run QA diffs and swap into prod tables behind a view swap. thoughts?
joel: that sounds right. couple notes: incremental job must dedupe using event_id and event_ts to avoid duplicates. also need to pin the kernel/runner image to avoid the schema mismatch we hit earlier.
sarah: agree. also we should mark the affected dashboards as stale in DataDog/Looker and set a banner in console so product teams know numbers will change after backfill.
analytics: +1 on banner. please include an estimated ETA and a rollback plan if the recompute introduces regressions.
mila: ETA estimate: dry-run replay + incremental recompute = ~90min if we throttle to 2x normal consumer throughput. Full speed would be ~25min but risks SLOs. we need eng-sre approval for transient throughput bump and quota increase on the batch cluster.
ashwin: pinging @eng-sre-bot — can we get a 2 hour quota bump to 3x for the batch cluster? we'll keep it limited to the backfill prefix and tag costs to TELEMETRY-BACKFILL.
eng-sre-bot: Request received: cluster-quota-bump for cluster=batch-prod, requested_multiplier=3, duration=2h. Please confirm from eng-platform and schedule start time. (ticket #SRE-2026)
mila: confirmed. target start 2026-11-02T02:00Z. performing dry-run at 01:40Z. will stream results here.
joel: prepare the recompute job with these flags:
```
backfill-runner --mode=incremental \
  --start=2026-11-01T03:00Z --end=2026-11-01T07:00Z \
  --dedupe-key=event_id --out-prefix=s3://redwood-telemetry/backfill/20261101/ \
  --runner-image=ghcr.io/redwood/recompute:v20261101-3
```
ashwin: + include `--dry-run` first then `--apply` if diffs are within thresholds. thresholds: <0.5% per-metric variance or manual signoff.
sarah: I'll draft the dashboard banner and a short note for the product slack channels. mila, assign me the final diff report please.
mila: assigned. joel, once dry-run looks good can you kick the apply and notify analytics for QA?
joel: will do. starting dry-run now.
eng-sre-bot: Reprocess job enqueued: job_id=backfill-20261101-07, mode=incremental, dry_run=true. ETA 85m. Monitor at https://infra.redwood/jobs/backfill-20261101-07
mila: thanks — keep logs and diffs attached. if the recompute changes >0.5% or introduces any NaNs we abort and revert to snapshot.
analytics: watching the diff. if anything looks off I’ll flag immediately. thanks for the quick triage :thumbsup:
ashwin: small follow-up: after successful apply we need to invalidate the cached prefixes in CDN and purge materialized views in front of dashboards. adding a cleanup step to the runbook.
mila: noted. postmortem owner assigned to @mila. I'll write a short incident blurb and link to the runbook: https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/telemetry-backfill
sarah: SGTM — will post banner at T-30m before apply.
joel: dry-run completed: diffs are <0.2% across tracked metrics, no NaNs, job size ~1.2GB. ready to apply on your go.
mila: go for apply at 2026-11-02T02:00Z.
eng-sre-bot: Reprocess job started: job_id=backfill-20261101-07, dry_run=false. live logs: https://infra.redwood/logs/backfill-20261101-07
joel: apply ran clean. swapped view at 02:38Z. purged caches and invalidated dashboards.
analytics: QA pass — numbers match expected downstream aggregates and user-facing metrics. closing analytics check.
sarah: banner removed. posting final note to product channels.
mila: thank you all. I'll open the postmortem and attach diffs + root cause. action items: (1) add schema compatibility check to deploy CI, (2) instrument consumer restarts for auto-replay, (3) small doc on backfill quotas. closing thread.
